The big boar stands on four legs and breathes heavily: its sides rise and fall, the head bobs slightly and the bristly mane twitches.
The big boar trots forward on its four legs with heavy steps, head low, mane bouncing.
The boar lowers its head with the long tusks pointed forward, crouches back on its hind legs and scrapes one front hoof backward once, then holds the lowered charging stance.
The boar lunges forward in a powerful charge with its head down and tusks thrust forward, then pulls up and stops.
The boar flinches, its head jerking back and body recoiling, then steadies.
The boar staggers, its legs buckle and it collapses onto its side and lies still.
